scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listeners) { $listeners | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; nodemon Backend/Server.js"
